subject: Renewal + capacity add-on — billing instructions & PO alignment
messages:
From: Liam Carter <liam@novapulse.io>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>
Cc: Amanda Reed <amanda@novapulse.io>
Date: Mon, 22 Nov 2027 09:15:00 +0000
Subject: Renewal + capacity add-on — billing instructions & PO

Hi Irene,

As discussed on last week's call, NovaPulse is ready to move forward with the 20% capacity add-on for Q1. Finance asked me to confirm how invoices should be routed since we have billing in two legal entities (NovaPulse Inc., US + NovaPulse EU B.V.).

Attached is a draft PO that our procurement team would like Redwood to use. Our ask: 1) Can you split the invoicing so 70% of the new capacity charge goes to the EU entity (with VAT applied) and 30% remains on the US entity? 2) Can we keep overall net terms at Net 45 for this renewal amendment?

Also attaching our EU VAT certificate and the PO draft (NP_PO_draft_20271122.pdf). Let me know if you need any other tax docs or a separate SOW for the add-on.

Thanks —
Liam
Liam Carter
Head of Procurement | NovaPulse
liam@novapulse.io
+44 20 7183 7000

Attachments: NP_PO_draft_20271122.pdf (application/pdf), NP_EU_VAT_cert.png (image/png)

From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>
To: Liam Carter <liam@novapulse.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Nov 2027 13:02:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Renewal + capacity add-on — billing instructions & PO

Hi Liam —

Thanks for the PO and VAT certificate. Looping in Ben (billing ops) and Marissa (account lead) so we can align legal/invoice routing. Quick answers and next steps:

- Split invoicing: we can support a split invoice across two legal entities, but we need the exact invoice-to addresses and tax IDs for both entities to reflect on the invoices. The EU VAT number you attached looks good — can you confirm the full legal name and billing address for NovaPulse EU B.V. as it should appear on the invoice?
- PO placement: we'll accept the PO number on both invoices; confirm the PO number you want us to stamp on each invoice line (single PO that references both entities is fine if procurement prefers).
- Net terms: Net 45 is acceptable for renewal amendment — I will note this in the amendment and the finance team will process under Net 45 if approved by Ben below.

Ben — can you advise if we should issue two separate invoices (one to US entity, one to EU BV) or a single invoice with a split line (we typically generate two invoices for tax clarity)? Also, we may need a tax-friendly breakdown in the SOW for the add-on — Marissa, do you want us to prepare an amendment SOW draft for signature?

Liam, if you prefer we can generate an amendment (DocuSign) that includes the split billing instructions and a one-line change to net terms. Once Ben confirms billing approach, I can send the DocuSign and an updated invoice sample.

Best,
Irene Choi
Senior Sales Ops Manager | Redwood Inference
irene@redwood.ai
415-555-0146

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>, Liam Carter <liam@novapulse.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Nov 2027 15:42:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Renewal + capacity add-on — billing instructions & PO

Hi all —

We reviewed the PO draft. For tax/audit clarity we prefer issuing two invoices:
- Invoice A to NovaPulse EU B.V. for 70% of the add-on charge (VAT applied).
- Invoice B to NovaPulse Inc. for 30% (no VAT).

Action items for NovaPulse to confirm:
1) Exact legal name + EU billing address for NovaPulse EU B.V. to print on Invoice A.
2) Confirm PO number to appear on both invoices (or provide two PO numbers).
3) Confirm whether NovaPulse can accept Net 45 for both invoices (we can apply Net 45 across the amendment).

Once we have (1)-(3) I'll create a sample Invoice A/B and the amendment doc. We will include the PO number and a short line in the SOW referencing the capacity split so your tax team has the breakdown.

Irene/Marissa — I'll need the amendment SOW text (one paragraph) and the amendment amount allocation to generate the two invoices and the DocuSign envelope.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Billing Ops Manager | Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.ai

From: Liam Carter <liam@novapulse.io>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>
Cc: Amanda Reed <amanda@novapulse.io>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 23 Nov 2027 14:02:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Renewal + capacity add-on — billing instructions & PO

Thanks Ben/Irene —

Confirming items below so we can get this into our AP system:
- Legal name for EU invoice: NovaPulse EU B.V.
  VAT ID: NL123456789B01
  Billing address: Herengracht 123, 1015 CJ Amsterdam, Netherlands
- PO number to use: NP-2027-1187 (please print on both invoices)
- Net terms: Net 45 accepted for both invoices

Amanda attached the final PO (NP_PO_draft_20271122.pdf) to this thread and our finance team will expect invoices to match the PO references exactly. We are good with two separate invoices (EU + US) per Ben's suggested flow.

Irene — please send the amendment DocuSign when ready. Marissa — quick note: our accounting prefers the amendment SOW to reference the new capacity quantity and the 70/30 billing split explicitly (one sentence).

Appreciate the quick turn — aiming to have signed and invoiced by end of next week.

Best,
Liam
